- U1: Upload custom modules using shell/rest-api (module registration via shell/REST)
- U2: Contribute modules that immediately reflect in module registry (dynamic registry, not hard-coded at bootstrap)
- U3: Move JMS module from XD to spring-cloud-stream-modules repo (source)
- U4: Move mail module from XD to s-c-s-m repo (source)
- U5: Move mongo module from XD to s-c-s-m repo (source... actually mongo could be source or sink; spec says "use it as source")
- U6: Move mqtt module from XD to s-c-s repo
- U7: Move reactor-ip module from XD to s-c-s repo
- U8: Move stdout module from XD to s-c-s repo

So this is essentially the historical work of creating the spring-cloud-stream-modules (app starters) from Spring XD modules, plus the module registry feature in Spring Cloud Data Flow (the AppRegistry).

technical_and_design_decisions: Replace the hard-coded ModuleRegistryPopulator bootstrap registration with a persistent, database-backed module registry (Spring Data repository) so registrations take effect immediately without restart (U2).

Expose module lifecycle management (register/unregister/list/upload) through a REST controller in the s-c-d server; module artifacts are referenced by Maven coordinates (group/artifact/version) with optional direct jar upload stored in a configurable artifact repository (U1).
Implement shell commands (module register/unregister/upload/list) as thin clients invoking the new REST endpoints, following the existing s-c-d shell command conventions (U1).
Registry changes are visible to stream/task definition creation immediately via the shared registry service (no caching staleness; lookups read through the persistent registry) (U2).

Create a spring-cloud-stream-modules style multi-module Maven build with a common parent POM and per-module application-starter structure; each migrated module becomes a standalone Spring Boot app using Spring Cloud Stream Binder abstractions (U3-U8).

Port each Spring XD module by migrating its options to @ConfigurationProperties metadata, adapting channel wiring to Spring Cloud Stream Source/Sink bindings, and reusing Spring Integration adapters where the XD module used them.

Provide unit tests per module plus integration tests using embedded or containerized infrastructure (embedded ActiveMQ for JMS, embedded Mongo/Testcontainers, Mosquitto for MQTT, GreenMail for mail, netcat-style socket tests for reactor-ip).
Keep each migrated module independently buildable and releasable, with generated option/metadata documentation.
assumptions: A single experienced developer (proficient in Spring, Spring Integration, Spring Cloud Stream, and familiar with the Spring XD codebase) performs all work.
The existing spring-cloud-dataflow (s-c-d) codebase and its build/CI environment are available and buildable; no environment setup or procurement time is included.
Migrated modules preserve the functional behavior of their Spring XD counterparts; no new features are added beyond the port.
Integration test infrastructure for external systems (JMS broker, MongoDB, MQTT broker, SMTP server) can be run locally via embedded components or containers without licensing/procurement delay.

Effort includes design, implementation, unit/integration testing, debugging, and documentation; it excludes elapsed-time factors such as code review wait, CI queue time, and release approval processes.
The 'reactor-ip' module is the most complex port due to TCP/UDP handling and Reactor-based async I/O, requiring more rework than the adapter-based modules.
No clarifying questions are needed; ambiguities in the specification (e.g., exact persistence store, upload artifact format) are resolved by the design decisions above.

activities.activity_description: Analyze U1-U8, design the persistent module registry, REST/shell upload API, and the target module-starter structure for migrated modules; produce design notes and task breakdown.
Implement database-backed module registry: entity model, Spring Data repository, and registry service replacing the hard-coded bootstrap populator, with immediate visibility of registrations.

activities.activity_name: Module upload/registration REST API (U1 server side)
activities.activity_description: Implement REST endpoints for registering, unregistering, listing, and uploading modules (Maven coordinates and jar upload), including validation and error handling.

activities.activity_name: Shell commands for module management (U1 client side)
activities.activity_description: Implement shell commands (module register/unregister/upload/list) invoking the new REST endpoints, with tab completion and output formatting consistent with existing shell commands.

activities.activity_name: Registry integration with stream/task definitions (U2 integration)
activities.activity_description: Wire the persistent registry into stream and task definition creation so newly contributed modules are immediately resolvable; remove legacy hard-coded population; add regression tests.

Set up the spring-cloud-stream-modules style multi-module Maven build: parent POM, starter conventions, Spring Cloud Stream binder test harness, and shared integration-test utilities used by all migrated modules.
Port the XD jms source module to a Spring Cloud Stream source starter: options metadata, SI JMS adapter wiring, unit tests, and integration tests against an embedded broker.
Port the XD mail source module to a Spring Cloud Stream source starter: IMAP/POP3 polling options, SI mail adapter wiring, unit tests, and GreenMail-based integration tests.
Port the XD mongo source module to a Spring Cloud Stream starter: options metadata, Spring Data MongoDB integration, unit tests, and embedded/containerized MongoDB integration tests.
Port the XD mqtt source module to a Spring Cloud Stream source starter: options metadata, SI MQTT adapter wiring, unit tests, and broker-based (e.g., Mosquitto) integration tests.

Port the XD reactor-ip module to a Spring Cloud Stream starter, reworking Reactor-based TCP/UDP async I/O to the new programming model; includes socket-level integration tests; highest complexity port.
Port the XD stdout sink module to a Spring Cloud Stream sink starter; simplest port with basic unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: End-to-end integration testing and defect fixing
activities.activity_description: End-to-end verification: upload modules via shell and REST, confirm immediate registry reflection, and build streaming pipelines using each migrated module; fix defects found.
Write reference documentation for module registration/upload (shell and REST), README and option documentation for each migrated module, and migration notes for XD users.
